actions.tookOver: A console is opening on the worker's conversation
actions.copyFailed: Could not copy: the browser refused clipboard access
actions.laneConflict: Refused: {files} are in the lane of {tasks}. Wait until those tasks finish or are reviewed.

attention.drivingDesc: The worker's conversation is open in a console. When you close it, the worker writes a hand-back report.

why.backgroundWait: The worker CLI waits for a command the worker started in the background. It is quiet, not stuck.
why.failed: The task failed. Look at the last turn, then follow up or start it again.

exit.timeout: {backend} was stopped at the turn's time limit.
exit.launcher_lost: The process that ran {backend} disappeared before it recorded how the turn ended.
exit.no_result: {backend} ended its turn (exit code {code}) without sending a result.

why.noResponse: The worker ended its turn without a report.
why.denied: The worker ended its turn without a report. Refused actions: {actions}
why.notStarted: The worker has not started {minutes} min after launch.
why.toolQuiet: No output for {minutes} min; last step {step}.
why.repeated: The worker repeated the same {tool} call {count} times in its last {steps} steps.
why.noAccounts: No {backend} account can run work. Sign one in or enable one.
why.auth: Every enabled {backend} account needs a sign-in.
why.depMissing: The earlier task {task} no longer exists.
why.hygiene: {count} hygiene finding to look at | {count} hygiene findings to look at
why.workAtRisk: {count} file may have lost changes | {count} files may have lost changes
why.resourcesWait: Waiting for resources for over {minutes} minutes: {available} free, needs {need}.
why.resourcesWaitPlain: Waiting for resources for over {minutes} minutes: the machine is short of free memory.

followup.label: Follow up
followup.placeholder: Ask the worker for more, in the same conversation…
followup.busy: The worker is busy. Follow up when it has finished, or cancel it first.
followup.driving: You are driving this task. Hand it back to follow up.
followup.waitingAnswer: The worker is waiting for your answer above.

review.acceptedDesc: The task is marked as reviewed. Tasks that wait for it can start.
review.rejectedDesc: The task is marked for redo. Say what to change; the notes are kept with the review.

confirm.cancelDesc: The worker stops now. Files it already changed stay as they are.
confirm.takeoverDesc: A console opens on the worker's conversation so you can continue it yourself.
confirm.takeoverActiveDesc: The running attempt stops, then a console opens on the worker's conversation so you can continue it yourself.

detail.notFound: This task could not be opened

safety.title: Safety checks

risk.desc: Uncommitted changes that were there before the turn are gone. Restore puts the files back from the snapshot taken before the turn.
risk.waitStop: Restore is possible once the worker has stopped.

why.large: large removal by an edit tool

risk.restoredDesc: Files were put back from the snapshot taken before turn {n}.
risk.restoredDescMany: Files were put back from the snapshots taken before their turns.
risk.truncated: Turn {n}: a snapshot hit its limits ({files} files or {mib} MiB of new content), so files past them were not checked.

finding.bomNewFile: New file starts with a byte order mark
finding.unreportedFile: Changed but not in the report

safety.blockedNote: The guard stopped these before they ran; nothing was changed.

parts.risk: {count} file at risk | {count} files at risk

restore.title: Restore files from before turn {n}?
restore.desc: The current content of these files is replaced with what they held before turn {n}. A backup of the current content is kept first.
restore.backup: What they held before is kept in the backup snapshot
restore.changedNote: These files changed after the turn ended, so they were left as they are.
restore.forceDesc: These files changed after the turn ended. Their newer content is replaced with what they held before turn {n}; a backup of it is kept first.

gate.title: Gate
gate.notYet: The gate runs when the worker reports.
gate.foreign: May be caused by {tasks}: it failed only in files that task changed. No automatic fix was started for it.
gate.settled: Ran again after waiting for the other tasks of the repository.

verifier.title: Second-opinion review
verifier.unverified: {n} cited lines do not match the repository:

lane.title: Lane
lane.none: No lane: any file may change

gate.off: Turned off (the lane is still checked, as information only)
gate.nextStep: The gate cannot fix this by itself any more: send a follow-up or take over the task.

queued.place: number {position} in line, {limit} at a time

gate.stoppedLowMemory: Stopped because the machine ran low on memory ({n} of {max}); the gate runs again once memory is back.
gate.lowMemory: The machine kept running out of memory: the gate was stopped {max} times.
gate.lowMemoryNext: Free some memory or lower “{setting}”, then run the gate again.

consults.title: Member opinions
consults.open: {count} objection to answer | {count} objections to answer
consults.objects: {who} objects; answer before accepting | {who} object; answer before accepting
consults.answerDesc: A peer objects to this work. Your answer is kept with the objection and the task is accepted.
